resources.string: Global defaults apply to every game unless a game sets its own override (in the game\'s settings or from the in-game menu).
Keeps clock speeds steady instead of spiking and dropping, so long sessions stay smoother. Safe, no root.
Gives the game\'s rendering higher priority than other apps for more CPU time. Safe, no root.
Pins the game to your fastest CPU cores instead of the efficiency cores. Safe, no root.
Forces the CPU to run fast instead of ramping on demand. Faster, more heat and battery. (Root)
Pins the CPU at max clock so it never slows down. Top performance, highest heat/battery. (Root)
Stops cores being put to sleep, keeping every core available. (Root)

Pins the GPU at top speed so it stops dropping clocks to save power. Smoother and more consistent, but hotter and heavier on battery.

No root is needed on Adreno (Qualcomm) GPUs: the app asks the GPU driver directly to stop scaling clocks down.

With root granted, it switches to a stronger system-level clock pin. The setting is undone when you exit the game, background the app, or it crashes.

On non-Adreno GPUs (Mali, Xclipse, PowerVR), this toggle needs root.
Removes your device\'s built-in heat protection. ⚠️ Can overheat — the Temperature Watchdog is your only safety net with this on. (Root)
Runs the fan at full speed for maximum cooling (devices with a fan). (Root)

Drops reclaimable file-system caches through the kernel drop-caches control. It does not close applications. The visible amount of free RAM may change only briefly because Android uses available memory for caches. (Root)
Locking the GPU to its maximum clock requires an Adreno (Qualcomm) GPU, or root on other GPUs.
No root manager detected (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch). Root controls stay disabled.
Thermal and fan controls are locked until safety-revert is verified on this device.
Frees cached files. Little visible RAM; the system reclaims cache automatically.
Automatically reverts all performance settings before the device gets too hot, based on your device\'s own thermal trip points. Keep this on unless you know what you\'re doing.
Auto-revert on game exit, app background, and crash is always on and cannot be disabled.

No root needed

Keeps clock speeds steady for smoother long sessions.

Gives the game more CPU time.

Pins the game to the fastest CPU cores.

Keeps GPU clocks at maximum; hotter and heavier on battery. Adreno can use this without root.

Requires root

• CPU governor → performance
Forces the CPU to run fast instead of ramping on demand.

• Lock CPU frequency to max
Pins the CPU at its maximum clock.

• Keep all cores online
Keeps every CPU core available.

• Disable thermal throttling
Removes built-in thermal protection; the watchdog becomes your safety net.

• Fan to maximum
Runs the device fan at full speed.

• Drop file caches
Releases reclaimable file-system caches without closing applications.

⚠️ USE AT YOUR OWN RISK — Power-user controls write directly to your device\'s system files (CPU/GPU clocks, thermal controls, fan). Misuse can cause overheating, instability, rapid battery drain, data loss, permanent hardware damage, and may void your warranty. Bannerlator provides these tools without warranty; you accept full responsibility for the outcome.
Your device did not expose thermal limits — using a safe %1$d °C fallback.
Manual: %1$d °C · ⚠ close to the hard limit (%2$d °C)

A safety backstop. If your device gets too hot, it automatically undoes the performance settings you enabled.

It does not throttle the device: Android's built-in thermal protection does that. The watchdog only reverts Bannerlator's changes.

It becomes essential if you disable thermal throttling, because then it is your only software safety net.

Presets: Conservative reverts near the normal throttle point; Balanced is recommended; Aggressive leaves little margin; Manual lets you set the value.

Reverting on game exit, app background, or crash is always enabled.

⚠️ DISABLING THERMAL SAFETY — The temperature watchdog is the only automatic protection that rolls back your settings before the device gets dangerously hot. With it off, your device can reach damaging temperatures with no software intervention while a game runs; only the chip\'s emergency trip remains. Do not leave this off unattended. This setting stays off across restarts until you enable it again.
Reverts near where your device would normally start throttling (~%1$d °C). Safest, least extra performance.
Lets the device run hot but reverts about 10 °C before its hard limit (~%1$d °C). Recommended.
Maximum sustained clocks, with only about 3 °C of margin before the hard limit (~%1$d °C). For experienced users.
You choose the exact revert temperature.
